description: This Java class manages external login keys for single sign-on authentication within OFBiz applications, including creation, cleanup, and validation of external login tokens.

classes.name: ExternalLoginKeysManager
classes.description: Manages external login key generation, validation, and cleanup for SSO between OFBiz applications.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an external login key for the request, creating and storing a new one if necessary.

methods.name: cleanupExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Removes the external login key associated with the session.

methods.name: checkExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Validates the external login key from the request and performs user authentication.

methods.name: isExternalLoginKeyEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether external login keys are enabled based on configuration.
